title: Fuling Outpost

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fuling Outposts are Points of interest found in the Plains. They look like isolated stone towers surrounded by wood stakes. They come in two variants.

sections.heading: Restored Outpost
sections.text:
The Restored Outpost variant has missing walls and the interior is visible from outside.
A Fuling totem is always present on an altar inside the building at the ground level. It is guarded by up to 6 Fulings with a 54% chance each.
The last floor has a 50% chance to be present, if so it has a Plains Chest and up to 3 additional Fulings with a 54% chance each.

sections.heading: Regular Outpost
sections.text:
The Regular Outpost variant is a full square stone tower with a single door entrance.
It is protected but up to 9 Fulings with a 54% chance each. The last floor has a 50% chance to be present, if so it has a Plains Chest and up to 2 additional Fulings with a 54% chance each.
Notably, this variant has no Fuling totem.
